note: Canonical hash = sha256('spyder-spectrum-v1\0' + float64-LE wavelengths + float64-LE values). v2 = v1 (27 spectra) + 3 numbered standard/high-res scan pairs.

spectra.name: synthetic_clip_vnir

spectra.name: synthetic_dark_x0.25
spectra.source: mmc2 row 78 x 0.25 (a constant absorbance offset of log10 4: the SG 2nd derivative removes it, so the prediction must equal the unmodified spectrum's to rounding)
